Security.label: Access Delay
Security.why: Identity and access controls in cloud adoption slow recovery by adding time-intensive verification steps during failover or migration, reducing rapid reliability improvements.

Cost.label: Higher Cloud Spend
Cost.why: Ensuring reliability typically requires duplicating cloud resources across regions with backups and snapshots, which raises operational costs.

Operational.label: More Complex Processes
Operational.why: Adding failover and health monitoring expands operational workflows, demanding extra stages in deployment and maintenance.

Performance.label: Slight Latency Increase
Performance.why: Data replication and health checks introduce marginal latency, slightly reducing application responsiveness under reliability measures.

Reliability.label: Access Delay
Reliability.why: Security verification steps slow down remediation and service restoration, limiting rapid gains in system reliability.

Cost.label: Security Tooling Cost
Cost.why: Deploying identity management, encryption, and threat detection tools elevates cloud expenditure.

Operational.label: Slower Deployment
Operational.why: Security validations add stages and approvals, reducing operational speed and agility.

Performance.label: Processing Overhead
Performance.why: Encryption and authorization consume compute, impacting overall application throughput.

Reliability.label: Fewer Backups
Reliability.why: Budget cuts can reduce backups and snapshots, increasing failure impact.

Security.label: Limited Security Features
Security.why: Cost constraints may limit advanced security safeguard deployment.

Operational.label: Minimal Tooling
Operational.why: Lower budgets reduce monitoring and automation tool availability.

Performance.label: Resource Constraints
Performance.why: Restricting resources impairs performance under demand spikes.

Reliability.label: Increased Failure Recovery Time
Reliability.why: More dependencies and complex processes extend time to recover from failures.

Security.label: Expanded Attack Surface
Security.why: Operational growth creates more potential vectors needing protection.

Cost.label: Increased Tooling Cost
Cost.why: Automation and monitoring tools add to operational costs.

Performance.label: Resource Optimization Effort
Performance.why: Continuous tuning for efficiency adds operational overhead.

Reliability.label: Risk of Overloaded Systems
Reliability.why: Maximizing throughput risks system overload without adequate reliability safeguards.

Security.label: Weakened Network Segmentation
Security.why: Reduced segmentation for speed opens up lateral attack paths.

Cost.label: Extra Scaling Costs
Cost.why: Scaling for peak performance causes elevated cloud expenditures.

Operational.label: Increased System Tuning
